between_rounds.title: City Bridge Foundation — Access to Justice
between_rounds.quote: We are not currently receiving applications. We'll share details of future funding opportunities on this page as they're confirmed. In May 2026, we awarded £6.5m of funding to 20 organisations across London in round one.
between_rounds.next_open: Round one closed; funded cohort announced May 2026. City Bridge says future opportunities will be posted on the programme page. No date given.

tag.title: Somerset Crisis and Resilience Alliance
tag.quote: We're looking for 2 types of Voluntary, Community, Faith, and Social Enterprise (VCFSE) partners to establish a joined-up, visible local support network: Community Anchors, which will be larger, established VCSFE groups with paid staff and a physical presence. Community Connectors, which will be smaller.
tag.note: Unincorporated included on purpose: the page explicitly wants smaller Community Connectors and faith groups, which are frequently unconstituted. Deadline of 4 Sep already stored and confirmed by the page ("Apply by: Friday 4 September 2026, by 5pm").
